name: Herdr Planner
author: Aleksey Abaydulin
description: Herdr Planner in the bar: one pill that opens the standalone dashboard in its own app window and marks a nearly exhausted agent limit.

barWidget.description: A pill that opens the Herdr Planner dashboard in an app window. The dashboard is a separate local web service (127.0.0.1 by default) and works without herdr.
